# KR-humanizer

KR-humanizer is an open-source, local-first Korean writing review and rewriting tool.
It offers opt-in next-sentence completion through an authenticated Codex EXEC process with the model fixed to gpt-5.3-codex-spark. It also diagnoses paragraphs and basic text issues, retrieves relevant Korean writing guidance from an Obsidian-compatible Markdown vault, invokes Codex CLI or Claude Code CLI for rewrites, and presents sentence-level changes for explicit acceptance.

## Canonical resources

- Website: https://kuseumkkrkkr.github.io/KR-humanizer/
- Installation: https://kuseumkkrkkr.github.io/KR-humanizer/guide/
- Knowledge vault: https://kuseumkkrkkr.github.io/KR-humanizer/knowledge/
- Source: https://github.com/kuseumkkrkkr/KR-humanizer
- Releases: https://github.com/kuseumkkrkkr/KR-humanizer/releases

## Boundaries

- It does not guarantee AI-detector evasion or authorship concealment.
- Rewrites preserve facts, numbers, proper nouns, claims, and the writer's stance, but the tool is not a fact checker.
- Community Skill cards are workflow observations, not official Korean-language norms.
